end.summary:
Aditya identified cube, cylinder, cone, sphere and cuboid in familiar toys and objects.
They practised matching solids with flat and curved faces.
They correctly described a cylinder as having two flat circular faces and one curved side.
They mixed up a matchbox with a cube and did not yet check whether all faces are equal squares.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming solid shapes using a dice, matchbox, water bottle, glue stick, rocket and ball. Aditya used the method of connecting shapes to familiar objects and correctly explained cylinder faces; the mix-up that every box is a cube was not corrected in the last seen response. At home, compare a dice, matchbox and shoe box by checking whether all faces are equal squares or whether the shape is longer.
